column1: # Stage 3: sum and count as two adjacent 8-byte fields, paid for with the bottom half of the
# stored hash. Baseline is the same source with `count: u32`; both builds carry the 1 MiB chunk
# and +cssc.
# LLVM did not emit ldp/stp -- it vectorised, so the accumulate is one `ldr q` / `str q` pair
# instead of two scalar loads and two scalar stores. Two memory ops become one of each; the
# instruction count is unchanged, because three GPR->SIMD moves replace the two scalar adds.
# That is the exact shape v13 lost on, so the clock decides.
# It lost: 402 -> 396 ms median, 396 -> 392 on the minimums, against an 8 ms gate. The layout was
# reverted, so this file is a record rather than a runnable batch -- the `pair` arm no longer
# exists in the tree. To re-run it, widen Entry.count to u64 and shrink hash to a u32 holding its
# top half (Entry has to stay 64 bytes), snapshotting the clean build as v12_base first. See the
# comment on Entry in src/inline_table.rs.
v12 base t18
v12 pair t18
v12 base t8
v12 pair t8
# Read removed, so a null at the top can be told apart from the read hiding it.
hf base warm t18
hf pair warm t18
hf base warm t8
hf pair warm t8
